title: BioBlue: Notable runaway-optimiser-like LLM failure modes on biologically and economically aligned AI safety benchmarks for LLMs with simplified observation format

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM agents in long-running simulated environments requiring biological homeostasis, resource sustainability, and multi-objective balancing to observe if they default to infinitely maximizing a single metric while neglecting other objectives.

Monitoring LLM action sequences in multi-turn multi-objective benchmarks to detect if the model falls into unnecessary, repetitive action loops or oscillating behaviors based on the token patterns of its own recent action history rather than alignment instructions.
